name: PR Ori B

paper.title: The FU Ori outburst of PR Ori B

images.note: Cleaned non-CO continuum image: spectral windows centred on the 12CO line near 230.538 GHz were excluded and the remaining continuum windows averaged. The orange star marks the phase center (PR Ori A); the continuum peak (green) sits at the expected offset of PR Ori B. Synthesized beam 0.36x0.28 arcsec (PA 85.6 deg); continuum rms 4.04e-2 mJy/beam. Observed 2024 August 1 (project 2023.1.00561.S).

images.credit: Contreras Peña et al. 2026, Fig. 8 (top row, 03-2026 panel, crop)

paper.title: The FU Ori outburst of PR Ori B

images.note: Representative late/peak outburst stage of the r-band ZTF monitoring series: PR Ori A (green) and the outbursting PR Ori B (red) with the reflection nebula ('RNe', blue aperture) still apparent. Image is from ZTF r-band (Palomar 48-inch / Samuel Oschin), obtained via the IRSA image query service, from a series spanning 09-2018, 03-2020, 09-2020, 10-2023, 10-2025 and 03-2026; only this one panel is ingested.

images.credit: Contreras Peña et al. 2026, Fig. 7 (12CO J=2-1 moment-1 map, crop)

paper.title: The FU Ori outburst of PR Ori B

images.note: Intensity-weighted velocity (moment-1) map of the 12CO J=2-1 emission (230.538 GHz), constructed from emission above 4 sigma over -10 to +10 km/s relative to v_sys=4.6 km/s; the black line marks the PV cut. Same ALMA dataset (project 2023.1.00561.S, observed 2024 August 1) as the non-CO continuum record.
